title: Bitcoin’s $80,000 buy wall hides a liquidation trap that could send prices toward $78,000
summary: Bitcoin registered an intraday low of $81,514.28 on Oct. 14 as September CPI came in hotter than forecast, with headline inflation at 3.7% year over year against 3.6% expected and core at 2.6% against 2.5%.
